William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

To Nancy F[laxman]: How can I help thy husband’s copying me?

XII
H
OW
 can I help thy husband’s copying me?
Should that make difference ’twixt me and thee?
